action_classes: Unwreck state and snapshot mutation command
extension.description: Reviews Unwreck CLI 0.1.0 invocations that restore or delete project and snapshot state, persist snapshots, change agent hook configuration, or launch child processes. Read-only inspection commands and the installed hook callback are outside this extension's matchers.
extension.name: Unwreck command protection

action_classes: Unwreck state and snapshot mutation command
permissions.description: Reviews Unwreck restore, undo, redo, garbage collection, snapshot, watch, and interactive TUI commands because they can rewrite project files or persist and remove local snapshot history. Restore and undo dry-runs and help requests are safe variants.
permissions.label: Unwreck state and snapshot changes
safer_guidance: Use `restore --dry-run` or `undo --dry-run` to inspect the proposed changes before applying them.
Review the target snapshot and retained history before running `gc`, `restore`, `undo`, or `redo`.
Remember that snapshots can include selected ignored files such as `.env`; keep the local snapshot store protected.

permissions.description: Reviews installation or removal of Unwreck hooks in Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI configuration. The --dry-run form only previews the configuration diff.
permissions.label: Unwreck agent hook configuration
safer_guidance: Preview hook installation or removal with `--dry-run` first.
Inspect the agent configuration diff and preserve existing user-defined hooks.

permissions.description: Reviews `unwreck run`, which starts the supplied child process while Unwreck monitors the working tree and snapshots changes.
permissions.label: Unwreck child process execution
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact child command and its arguments before running it through Unwreck.
Use the agent's normal command review for the underlying process as well; this rule does not replace protections for the child command.

action_classes: Unwreck state and snapshot mutation command
rules.description: Identifies Unwreck 0.1.0 operations that restore or modify project files, persist or delete local snapshots, or open the interactive restore interface. Help and explicit dry-run commands narrow this rule.
safer_alternatives: Use `restore --dry-run` or `undo --dry-run` to inspect changes without writing to the project.
Inspect `log` and `diff` output before choosing a snapshot to restore.
Review the snapshot retention policy before deleting stored history with `gc`.
rules.title: Unwreck state and snapshot mutation

rules.description: Identifies `unwreck hooks --write` and `unwreck hooks --remove`, which modify Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI configuration. The dry-run option only previews the diff.
safer_alternatives: Run `unwreck hooks --write --dry-run` or `unwreck hooks --remove --dry-run` to inspect the configuration diff.
Use the narrowest intended agent and scope instead of changing every agent configuration.
rules.title: Unwreck agent hook configuration change

rules.description: Identifies `unwreck run`, which launches a caller-supplied child process while monitoring and snapshotting the working tree.
safer_alternatives: Review the exact child executable and arguments before launching the process.
Keep the underlying command subject to its own command and policy checks.
rules.title: Unwreck child process execution

safer_alternatives: Preview restore, undo, and hook configuration changes with their dry-run options.
Inspect the exact command before using `unwreck run` to launch a child process.
Review snapshot retention and protect the local snapshot store.
